purpose: Multi-market market-data SDK/API with US-stock quotes, minute bars, transactions/depth, WebSocket streaming and institutional/ETF holdings surfaces.
latencySuitability: UNVERIFIED_MEDIUM_HIGH: WebSocket surface exists, but no independent US-feed latency/coverage benchmark was found in this sweep.
maintenance: Repository created 2026-07-13 and last pushed 2026-07-22 at review time; very young project with one star and no releases established in this review.
docsTests: README is detailed and repository contains quote/minute/strategy/WebSocket tests. WebSocket tests verify header-based API-key handling, connection-open sequencing and server-close error propagation.
securityNotes: Positive: API key is sent by x-api-key header rather than query string. Concern: default service endpoint is a bare IP address and the SDK is tightly coupled to a vendor-hosted API. Credentials must never enter TAGX GitHub Pages/browser production path.
resilienceNotes: Current WebSocket implementation has connection timeout and close/error propagation but no demonstrated automatic reconnect/resubscribe, stale-data timeout, heartbeat freshness classification or exponential backoff. This is materially weaker than the patterns already reviewed in alpaca-py.
lookAheadBiasRisk: MEDIUM for vendor strategy/backtest endpoints because feature/outcome construction is opaque to TAGX; raw quote/minute/transaction streams are lower risk if event timestamps are preserved.
dataProvenanceRisk: HIGH_UNVERIFIED: upstream exchange/vendor provenance, US extended-hours coverage and redistribution rights were not independently established from repository code/docs alone.
integrationPlan: Do not add dependency or credentials. Borrow only two verified patterns: header-only secret transport and explicit WebSocket close/error handling. Revisit only if provenance, US extended-hours coverage, stale-stream detection and reconnect benchmarks become independently verifiable.
whyNotBuild: TAGX already has higher-confidence official candidates (Databento/Alpaca) with clearer provenance. Adding a young vendor abstraction would expand data and security uncertainty without a demonstrated latency or early-capture lift.
